name: Malaysian Association for the Blind
summary: Helps blind and visually impaired Malaysians live independently through education, rehabilitation, vocational training and advocacy.
programmes: Rehabilitation and training centres (Gurney, MAB Rehabilitation & Training Centre)
Taman Harapan agricultural training centre in Temerloh
Low vision clinic and H.T. Ong Library
Massage roadshows and homeworker scheme for income
beneficiaries: Blind and visually impaired people, including those with multiple disabilities

organisation.leadership: Tan Sri Tengku Azlan Sultan Abu Bakar (President, per Malay Mail Jan 2024; not listed on site)
